_meta.method: Same circumplex valence/arousal convention as emotions.json ([-1, 1]).
_meta.groups: Split into two groups of at most 9 situations each so that, with the always-present none_of_these option, every Laya choice question stays at 10 options or fewer (11+ is uncalibrated): 'active_social' (higher-energy, other-facing contexts) and 'calm_personal' (lower-energy, solitary or reflective contexts).
_meta.description_format: Each description is concrete and bilingual (English then Spanish), listing typical cues a listener actually says, so the choice-question criteria text has enough surface overlap with real prompts to be compared reliably against.

active_social.label: Fiesta
active_social.description: Going to or hosting a lively party with friends: dancing, drinks, loud music, celebration, a club or a house party / Ir a una fiesta o armarla con amigos: bailar, chupe, música fuerte, pachanga, antro o reventón.

active_social.label: Entrenamiento
active_social.description: Working out or training: gym, running, lifting weights, cardio, sweating, pushing through a hard set / Entrenar o hacer ejercicio: gimnasio, correr, levantar pesas, cardio, sudar, echarle ganas a la rutina.

active_social.label: Viaje por carretera
active_social.description: A long road trip or drive with friends: open highway, packing the car, windows down, anticipation of a trip / Viaje largo por carretera con amigos: la autopista, cargar el coche, ventanas abajo, ganas de viajar.

active_social.label: Manejando de noche
active_social.description: Driving alone at night: empty roads, city lights, headlights, a solitary and moody late-night drive / Manejando solo de noche: calles vacías, luces de la ciudad, un viaje nocturno solitario y melancólico.

active_social.label: Cita romántica
active_social.description: A romantic date: dinner with a crush or partner, first date nerves, candlelight, flirting / Una cita romántica: cenar con la persona que te gusta o tu pareja, nervios de primera cita, velas, coqueteo.

active_social.label: Reunión con amigos
active_social.description: Casually hanging out with friends: chatting on the couch, having a few drinks at home, laughing, no big plans / Reunión tranquila con amigos: platicar en el sillón, echar unas chelas en casa, reírse, sin planes grandes.

active_social.label: Celebración
active_social.description: Celebrating an achievement, birthday or milestone: a toast, good news, pride and joy shared with others / Celebrar un logro, cumpleaños o fecha especial: un brindis, buenas noticias, orgullo y alegría compartida.

active_social.label: Cocinando
active_social.description: Cooking or baking at home: chopping vegetables, following a recipe, the kitchen, preparing a meal / Cocinando u horneando en casa: picar verduras, seguir una receta, la cocina, preparar la comida.

calm_personal.label: Noche de película
calm_personal.description: A relaxed movie or series night at home: popcorn, snacks, sofa, Netflix, dimming the lights, cozy low-stakes entertainment / Noche de película o serie en casa: palomitas, botanas, sillón, Netflix, apagar las luces, plan tranquilo y cómodo.

calm_personal.label: Estudiando
calm_personal.description: Studying or reviewing material for an exam: books, notes, highlighting, flashcards, sometimes stressed about a deadline / Estudiando o repasando para un examen: libros, apuntes, subrayar, fichas, a veces estresado por una fecha de entrega.

calm_personal.label: Durmiendo
calm_personal.description: Winding down to fall asleep: lying in bed, dimming the lights, insomnia, trying to sleep, minimal stimulation / Preparándose para dormir: acostado en la cama, luces bajas, insomnio, tratando de dormir, mínima estimulación.

calm_personal.label: Día de lluvia en casa
calm_personal.description: A quiet rainy day staying indoors: watching the rain through the window, a blanket, tea, unhurried and introspective / Un día de lluvia en casa: ver llover por la ventana, una cobija, un café o un té, tranquilo y pensativo.

calm_personal.label: Superando una ruptura
calm_personal.description: Processing a breakup or heartbreak: an ex, missing someone, crying, healing slowly, moving on from a relationship / Superando una ruptura o desamor: un ex, extrañar a alguien, llorar, sanar poco a poco, dejar atrás una relación.

calm_personal.label: Rutina matutina
calm_personal.description: Starting the day: waking up, coffee, showering, getting dressed, getting ready to leave the house / Empezar el día: despertarse, tomar café, bañarse, vestirse, prepararse para salir de casa.

calm_personal.label: Trabajando concentrado
calm_personal.description: Deep-focus work or study session at a desk: emails, coding, writing, needing concentration and no distractions / Trabajar concentrado en el escritorio: correos, programar, escribir, necesitar enfoque y cero distracciones.
